title: Bulk enrolment from the customer's Assets tab
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A customer with several active assets, some already on the target schedule and some with prior history. Seed: a customer with 4+ assets; enrol one or two on the target schedule beforehand.
custom_steps:
1. On the customer's Assets tab find "Enroll in maintenance schedule" beside New Asset and open it.
  2. Use the Assets section: checkboxes, Select all, and search; note greyed assets and the action label.
  3. Pick a schedule and read what the modal says about last-service dates and certificates.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The customer's Assets tab has "Enroll in maintenance schedule" beside New Asset; it opens the modal with an Assets section listing every active asset (checkbox + Select all) and a search matching type, make, unit and VIN.
  • An asset already on the chosen schedule is greyed, cannot be ticked, and reads "Already on this schedule"; the action reads "Enroll N assets".
  • Bulk enrolment asks for no last-service dates and no certificates - each asset takes its dates from its own history and the modal says how many have one (e.g. "8 of 12 have a last service on record; the rest count from today"); it works for one customer at a time, with no path across customers and none from the schedule side.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10564 (S7, Enrol an asset onto a schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S7; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R24: “The customer's Assets tab has Enroll in maintenance schedule beside New Asset. It opens the enrolment modal with an Assets section: every active asset of that customer with a checkbox and Select all, and a search matching type, make, unit and VIN”
  • S7-R25: “In the Assets section an asset already on the chosen schedule is greyed, cannot be ticked, and reads Already on this schedule. The action reads Enroll N assets”
  • S7-R26: “Bulk enrolment asks for no last service dates and no certificates. Each asset takes its dates from its own history ... 8 of 12 have a last service on record; the rest count from today”
  • S7-N7: “Bulk enrolment works for one customer at a time, from that customer's Assets tab. There is no enrolment across customers”
  • S7-N4: “There is no bulk path from the schedule side”
  • S7-E4: “An asset may be enrolled on more than one schedule. Overlapping services are allowed and produce separate rows”
